{{short description|Music archaeologist and physicist}}

'''Bo Lawergren''' is a [[music archaeologist]] and [[physicist]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Bo Lawergren |publisher=Nordic Harp Meeting |url=https://nordic-harp-meeting.eu/bo-lawergren/ |access-date=29 September 2021 }}</ref> A Professor Emeritus of [[physics]] at [[Hunter College]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.hunter.cuny.edu/physics/faculty/lawergren/home |title=Professor Emeritus Bo Lawergren |work=Department of Physics and Astronomy, Hunter College |accessdate=26 January 2010 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110607062905/http://www.hunter.cuny.edu/physics/faculty/lawergren/home |archivedate=2011-06-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref> he received his [[PhD]] in [[nuclear physics]] from the [[Australian National University]] of [[Canberra]], Australia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://hunter-cuny.academia.edu/BoLawergren/CurriculumVitae|title=Bo Lawergren &#124; Hunter College - Academia.edu}}</ref>
